name: td-import-exemption-eligibility
description: Chad import-exemption eligibility working paper for the September 2026 order covering listed cereals, livestock feed, water equipment and forage-crop production equipment. Use it to separate the goods named in Arrêté 135 from a mixed shipment, document the intended use required by its wording, and identify lines that need a customs classification decision. It covers the order effective from its signature on 9 September 2026, not earlier imports. Wheat is excluded pending reconciliation with the finance law, and uncertain origin or classification triggers a hold. Two executable cases reconcile the supported invoice lines and unresolved lines. This is a narrow cross-border preparation job, not a customs return, tariff classification service, landed-cost computation or certification of the wider Chad tax pack. No accountant has attested to it.
